task.description: Produce the fix design for ISS-0276 per docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md Step 2. Read handoffs/WF03-ISS0276-20260822/step-01-issue-fixer.json's result.summary in full -- it is ISSUE-FIXER's complete diagnosis and 'WHAT A FIX MUST ADD' section naming the exact call chain, idempotency question, LETFLOW_DEV_DB_CONFIRMED question, and documentation requirement. Design a new Mix.Task (mix letflow.seed, matching the lib/mix/tasks/ naming convention) that provisions a default tenant (slug bpm-default, idp_realm_id bpm-default) via Letflow.Identity.create_tenant/1 -> Letflow.TenantProvisioning.provision_tenant_schema/1 -> Letflow.TenantProvisioning.replay_migrations/1. Your design must explicitly resolve: (a) the exact attrs map passed to create_tenant/1, (b) idempotency behavior when a bpm-default tenant already exists (create_tenant/1 returns {:error, :duplicate_slug} today), (c) whether/how the task interacts with the LETFLOW_DEV_DB_CONFIRMED=1 guard in lib/letflow/repo.ex, (d) where documentation of the new command goes (README.md or docs/) satisfying AC3. Design artefact only -- signatures, @specs, module/function shapes, and prose describing behavior. NO implementation code bodies.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers all 3 of ISS-0276's stated acceptance criteria (fresh-DB seed creates the row; an authenticated bpm-default-realm request then resolves a tenant; the path is documented)
Design explicitly states the mix task's module name, invocation (mix letflow.seed), and its call sequence against the three named Identity/TenantProvisioning functions
Design explicitly resolves idempotency (re-run behavior) and the LETFLOW_DEV_DB_CONFIRMED interaction -- not left as an open question for ELIXIR-DEV to invent
Design names the exact doc location and what text is added
No .ex function bodies / no compilable implementation code in the design doc -- signatures and prose only
